historical_v3_receipt.resident_fixture: Engine-authored AnimationPlayer POSITION_3D track on each actual original imported skeleton. None of these four originals contains native resident AnimationPlayers. This proves engine control ownership, not original-game resident animation identification.
historical_v3_receipt.ownership_contract: Call controller.release() / Source.clear(binding) before a newer caller request, including same-clip requests; stale clear is idempotent. No claim of detecting arbitrary same-clip changes without public generation information.
limitations: No renderer/window/GPU deformation inspection. Camera fit uses actual imported mesh AABBs, not animated deformation bounds.
Sample interpolation is deterministic model-space TRS; no original cinematic scheduling or actor timing is inferred.
Raw material inventory acceptance remains prior narrow scope; original shader/raster/material visual fidelity, exports and all96 remain OPEN.
Runtime pins are manifest scope, not complete transitive DLL proof.
Headless logs contain an environment root certificate store warning; no SCRIPT ERROR, Parse Error or Compile Error in accepted run.
